final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT m.link_to_major, ma.college, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS ma ON CAST(m.link_to_major AS BLOB) = CAST(ma.major_id AS BLOB) GROUP BY m.link_to_major, ma.college), shares AS (SELECT link_to_major, college, group_count, 1.0 * group_count / SUM(group_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), college_averages AS (SELECT college, AVG(share) AS college_average FROM shares GROUP BY college) SELECT s.link_to_major, s.college, s.group_count, s.share, s.share - ca.college_average AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN college_averages AS ca ON CAST(s.college AS BLOB) = CAST(ca.college AS BLOB) WHERE s.share > ca.college_average ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
